# RhinoBling

RhinoBling is the B2B brand of Hangzhou MisiShell Import & Export Co., Ltd., supplying custom rhinestone products for wholesale buyers, boutiques, gift companies, importers and online sellers.

## Core collections
- Custom rhinestone tumblers, coffee cups and water bottles
- Rhinestone handheld mirrors and beauty accessories
- Rhinestone pill boxes, keychains, bag charms and promotional gifts
- Crystal footwear and fashion accessories
- OEM logo, pattern, color and retail packaging customization

## Buyer information
- MOQ varies by product and customization complexity.
- Samples are available for selected products.
- Bulk production starts after sample or design confirmation.
- Quality checks cover appearance, crystal placement and protective packaging.
- Character and third-party brand designs require appropriate authorization.
